newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Dec 10.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices edged lower on Tuesday, tracking crude and cargo levels, traders said. Traders said volumes were light. A major said he had sold a total of 2,000 tonnes of 380-cst supplies at around $121-$122. Sellers said 180-cst supplies continued to be tight due to expensive cutter stocks. --- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3082)
